data.title: Food, Fresh Produce and Groceries
data.summary: 140 original food and grocery models: fruit and vegetables built as real bodies, cut and halved forms, the chilled counter, bakery, dry goods, tins and drinks, with the crates and bags that hold them.
data.description: A supermarket shop modelled as food rather than as tinted spheres. Fruit and vegetables are lofted organic bodies with real ribbing, lobes and lumpy skins; cut and halved forms carry filled cut faces with pith, segments, stones and seeds, and they face the camera so a thumbnail shows the inside. Alongside the produce: the chilled counter of dairy, eggs, meat and fish, the bakery shelf, dry goods in slumped bags, tins and jars with rolled rims and shouldered profiles, drinks, and the crates, trays, baskets, bags and signage a greengrocer displays it all in. Real supermarket sizes throughout, no brand marks or printed text anywhere, and three composed layouts showing a fruit display, a vegetable stall and an unpacked weekly shop. Static CC0 geometry.

starterScene.summary: A shop-front fruit display: six timber crates on two ranks heaped with apples, oranges, pears, citrus, kiwis, plums, avocados and mangoes, a stepped riser behind them carrying a watermelon, a pineapple and coconuts, a wicker basket of grapes and a turned bowl of bananas...

Static layout; no rig, collision or navigation data.
